scope: Single local batch then stream replay per retained PDF under process-bound idle-sleep assertion. Warm filesystem effects and order are not controlled. Excludes running-matter audit, source retrieval, generation, model review and delivery; not complete-book or customer-path acceptance.
quality_checks: JPEG and PNG contact sheets and page rasters byte-identical
Every physical page covered exactly once
First sheet available before a deliberately blocked later Poppler range completes
Shorter repaired PDF removes obsolete rasters and sheets
Raster failure drains every child and started confirmation; partial review remains incomplete
Screening and confirmation retain the existing shared concurrency and spending ceilings
discarded_timing: Earlier prototype baseline took an unexplained 245.5 seconds and had no verified continuous power state. That raw result is retained privately and excluded from the comparison.
